name: What are the first steps to plan a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps to plan a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first steps in planning a bathroom remodel involve defining your needs and budget. Start by identifying what you dislike about your current bathroom and what you hope to achieve. Collect inspiration photos and create a list of desired features and materials. Establish a realistic budget, including a contingency for unforeseen issues. Research and contact reputable general contractors for consultations and estimates. A good plan ensures a smoother project from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin by defining your needs, setting a realistic budget, gathering inspiration, and then contacting general contractors for consultations and estimates.
